summary: The old harness has two possible preexisting read-sequence blockers. Their consequences depend on source behavior absent from the supplied evidence, so maintenance necessity remains unknown. The only code change initializes a newly allocated read buffer; the other selected changes alter comments.

claims.necessity_reason: The harness calls png_start_read_image after png_read_update_info has initialized the row. Both versions report an application error for that sequence, but the supplied evidence does not establish whether that error aborts this build or otherwise invalidates an existing harness operation.
